mapper.select: SELECT ur.region_id AS area_id, ur.region_name AS area_name, r.region_id AS bay_id, r.region_name AS bay_name, d.device_id, d.device_name, "7" AS appearance_type, "2" AS save_type_list, "2" AS point_type, "0" AS photo_num, d.device_id AS main_device_id, d.device_name AS main_device_name, da.voltage_level, d.device_type, "2" AS data_type, CONCAT(da.longitude, ';', da.latitude) AS master_coordinate, d.device_id master_point_id, "0" AS Args FROM t_std_device d LEFT JOIN t_std_device_attr da ON d.device_id = da.device_id LEFT JOIN t_std_region r ON d.up_region_id = r.region_id LEFT JOIN t_std_region ur ON r.up_region_id = ur.region_id WHERE ur.region_id = #{regionId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and d.position_type = 'simple'
